html:
**A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience.

Not Raised by Wolves is a third-person shooter where you play as La Coyota, an anthropomorphic gunslinger fighting through an ancient AI facility to rescue her colony’s pups. Armed with a trusty revolver and aided by your robotic sidekick, you’ll dash, aim, and shoot your way to victory.

Use your revolver’s dual firing modes to adapt to every encounter, and unleash your drone’s hacking ability to temporarily stun enemies, expose their weak points, and set up the perfect kill shot. Every fight demands quick reflexes, clever use of your tools, and the grit to keep moving forward.
